cohort: 54 neonates with HIE treated by therapeutic hypothermia and a control group of neonates born in the same period, gestational age-matched diagnosed with fetal distress
finding: Characteristic fetal monitoring patterns including indeterminate baseline heart rate, bradycardia, low variability, and higher baseline fetal heart rate, together with acute obstetric emergency events like rupture of a previous uterine cesarean scar and placental abruption, were associated with neonatal HIE.
